steps.do: Click Import, name it prod-refund-intake, Choose file ticket-intake.v1.workflow.yaml (lab 09's version 1), Validate dependencies, Import as new. In the editor click Publish: Validate, Next, Next, Publish.
steps.see: Preflight passed, then the editor, then Published. This is the workflow "already running in production".

steps.where: Agent resources › Workflows › editor › Run Monitor
steps.do: Open Run Monitor, paste a ticket (a row's input.payload), click Run, wait for the badge, and repeat for P01 to P40.
steps.see: 12 runs end failed, 28 completed; each records a trace (Open in Observability in the run's Execution Trace panel).

steps.do: Open Observability. Set Filter by status to Error, then OK, then All statuses.
steps.see: Error shows only ERROR rows (12 per time the 40 tickets were sent), OK shows 28 per time. Each row's request is the ticket. A trace that has just ended can read IN_PROGRESS for a moment; the list refreshes itself every five seconds, under any filter, so a failure that had not closed when you opened the page appears without a reload.

steps.do: Search T-5035 in Search traces and open the row (the id lands in the URL as ?trace=). Read the Spans tree.
steps.see: For the poison ticket T-5035: workflow.run ERROR, node.validate OK, node.check_reference ERROR (2.04 s). For the upstream ticket T-5038: node.lookup OK and node.decide ERROR.
steps.asset: root cause read from the node tree

steps.do: Search with no match, then open an unknown trace. Type no-such-ticket-zzz in Search traces, then open /caliber/observability?trace=tr-doesnotexist.
steps.see: The empty state, then trace 'tr-doesnotexist' not found (a 404).

steps.where: Prompt lifecycle › Test Sets › + New Test Set
steps.do: Create the test set Observability will capture into. Name prod-regression, owner @admin, Create.
steps.see: The test set is listed. (Observability can only add to an existing test set.)

steps.where: Operate › Observability › Add to test set; Test Sets › Capture from trace
steps.do: Capture failures. In Observability open the T-5038 trace, choose prod-regression under Add to test set and click Add example. Then open the test set, click Capture from trace, paste the T-5035 trace id and click Capture.
steps.see: Two examples. Each input is the ticket, tagged from-trace and trace:<id>.

steps.do: Put the gold outcome on a captured example. A capture stores the response as the expected answer, and for a failed run that is the error text. Click Edit on the first example, set Expected (JSON object) to {"decision": "manual_review", "reason_code": "ACCOUNT_LOOKUP_FAILED", "upstream_status": 503} and Save.
steps.see: The example becomes version 2 and shows the gold outcome.
steps.asset: gold outcome on a captured example

steps.do: Create the triage queue from triage-review.review-questions.json: name prod-triage, then add the five questions with + Add question (key, title, type, target, and the options for failure_mode and severity) and click Create queue.

Enqueue and review two traces. Select the queue, paste the trace ids of T-5038 and T-5025 (a wrong OK trace) into Trace ids and click Enqueue. For each: Pass, pick Where did it fail? and Operational severity, fill What should the run have produced? and Triage notes, Submit review.
Open the T-5038 trace again and read Assessments.
steps.see: failure_mode tool and severity high are listed with the other three answers: the review was written back onto the trace.

steps.do: Open prod-refund-intake, tab Versions, Restore as draft on v1. In the editor click the validate node and replace its Code with assets/fix/validate.py; do the same for check_reference and decide. Save, then Publish.
In Run Monitor run P25 to P40 again. In Observability search T-5038, click Compare and select both rows.
steps.see: All 16 runs complete with the gold outcome. T-5038 has two traces, OK (version 2) above ERROR (version 1); the comparison shows them side by side.

steps.where: Agent resources › Workflows › Versions › Compare versions
steps.do: Open prod-refund-intake, tab Versions, Compare versions: base v1, newer v2.
steps.see: The panel lists the changed nodes, check_reference among them.
